headline: TOASTER FESTIVAL
chyron: WELLINGTON: MOST BORING TOWN IN THE WORLD?
ticker: TOASTER FESTIVAL ENTERS DAY THREE OF ONE
CAREERCRASH.ORG: THE BAKER HAS OPINIONS ON TOAST

beats.text: Tonight we go to the other side of the world, to our Asia-Pacific Bureau. Hamish, can you hear me?
Loud and clear, Brock! Massive morning here in Wellington. Well. Tomorrow morning.
And Hamish, buddy, those toasters behind you. Man, those toasters are MASSIVE!
The big story, Philippa, is the Wellington Toaster Festival. Forty toasters. Outdoors. In this wind.
They're regular toasters, Brock. Regular size.
Philippa! Why would you ASK him that?
It's journalism, Brock. Who, what, where, how tall.
Five foot two, Philippa. Five foot four in a northerly.
Can't say too much, but you're going to LOVE Thursday.
Hamish, what happens on THURSDAY?! TELL ME!

realStory.text: Made up. Wellington is a lively, famously windy harbour capital; BSN's newsroom has simply never been. There is no Toaster Festival. Yet.

signoff: Hamish says thanks for having him. We heard it about four seconds later.
